scope: The sole common interface rescue. Restore the inherited contextual-GRU scalar critic; learned forecasts only correct pedestrian positions in its native .25s successor query. Physical forecasts receive legal future-motion supervision only. This is not an isolated gradient-decoupling ablation and not a KDA-only rescue.
sensor: 360-degree centre-ray human-body occlusion; no range cutoff or random dropout
association: Ideal association of previously visible actors; identity is not a numeric model input
primary: 10/20-person SR equally weighted across native circle and square; 5-person and per-geometry outcomes separately reported
checkpoint_selection: Final fixed-budget checkpoint reloaded for evaluation. No outcome-based selection. CV reuses verified original V8 contextual-GRU final weights after native score/action parity; reuse is not new training.
prediction_loss: Original scalar MC-return MSE for the inherited critic plus0.1 velocity-normalized later-legal-visible displacement MSE for the predictor. No cross-module gradients; independently clip each module to norm1. Same optimizer, rates, updates and schedules.
common_consumer: Original V8 contextual-GRU critic, same23-frame observed candidate prefix and native one-step successor. Add shared physical forecast residual at .25s to successor human positions and consistently recompute distance/inverse-TTC/nearfield; velocities/radii/age/masks stay native. Reward/filter/clearance/smoothing remain based on inherited CV. Observed critic training has no forecast input.
predictor_current_contract: Identical to A: own lawful24-frame history, legal current absolute actor position, current retained neighbours, no hidden goals or ORCA states. The existing GRU compacts measured frames; KDA uses elapsed observation intervals. This clock-handling distinction is an explicit limitation, not claimed equal temporal capability.
parent_reference: CV wrapper contains precisely the original final V8 gru_context critic and no learned predictor. Checkpoint hashes, original demonstrations and budgets are verified. Re-evaluate wrapper on the same per-seed GPU; require exact command and outcome parity with stored GPU Parent.
allowed_rescue: This consumes the one allowed interface repair. No additional mechanism rescue, gate sweep or hyperparameter search follows B.
stopping: Complete all12 learned runs plus four CV reference evaluations. An advantage must exceed all strong controls under the predefined primary/safety/progress rules, then undergo fresh confirmation. Prediction improvement or action sensitivity alone is not success. If B fails, stop this bounded attempt, not the entire temporal family.
